title: Woman
subtitle: Some evidence is specific. Some context always applies.
description: Evidence relevant to pregnancy, development, reproduction or a documented difference between sexes — when it exists, and when it does not.
why_body: For decades, nutritional and toxicological research focused on the general population. Where evidence specific to women's biology exists, BOTIA shows it. Where it does not, BOTIA says so rather than assuming.
what_body: BOTIA works in two ways here. When the label declares an ingredient with documented evidence relevant to pregnancy, development or reproduction, BOTIA flags it directly. BOTIA also shows a general BPA signal that does not depend on an ingredient being declared on the label.
can_1: Detect declared ingredients backed by an official assessment relevant to pregnancy, development or reproductive health.
can_2: Show the general BPA signal even when it does not come from the ingredient list.
can_3: Point to the specific assessment behind each finding.
cannot_1: Diagnose, assess personal risk, or replace medical advice.
cannot_2: Determine actual BPA exposure from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_3: Tell you what to eat or avoid — that decision is always yours.
closing: Evidence when it exists. Context when it does not. Never a verdict.
